'F2 aA^p(1+b t^q)': (lambda p: p[0]*A**p[1]*(1+p[2]*t**p[3]), [1,0.5,0.1,3]),

'F5 aA/(1+bA)+c t^q': (lambda p: p[0]*A/(1+p[1]*A)+p[2]*t**p[3], [3,0.3,0.1,3]),
'F6 aA^p exp(b t^q)': (lambda p: p[0]*A**p[1]*np.exp(p[2]*t**p[3]), [1,0.5,0.01,2]),
'F7 aA^p + b t^q A': (lambda p: p[0]*A**p[1]+p[2]*t**p[3]*A, [1,0.5,0.1,3]),
'F8 (a+bt^q)A^p': (lambda p: (p[0]+p[2]*t**p[3])*A**p[1], [1,0.5,0.1,3]),
'F9 aA/(1+bA)*(1+c t^q)': (lambda p: p[0]*A/(1+p[1]*A)*(1+p[2]*t**p[3]), [3,0.3,0.1,3]),
'F10 aA^p+b t^q A^s+c': (lambda p: p[0]*A**p[1]+p[2]*t**p[3]*A**p[4]+p[5], [1,0.5,0.1,3,0.5,0]),
}
